contenders.handicapper_notes: Brings the strongest proven stamina profile and highest benchmark form figures (64 to 72 ratings) into this maiden. Second-up today after a sharp runner-up effort over 1400m at Nowra where he led throughout. Faces a top-weight tax at 59.0kg (-3 pts) over 1450m, but has placed at metropolitan Canterbury and provincial premier venues. Maps to sit right on or just off the speed as canonical presser (P) and looks very hard to beat.

Progressive Maurice 3yo gelding from the premier Ciaron Maher stable. Good debut 2nd at Hawkesbury over 1300m followed by an honest 6th (beaten 2.6L) at Newcastle in slick time. Step up to 1450m on the spacious Kembla Grange circuit is ideal. Carries 58.0kg (-2 pts effective weight tax) but possesses superior sectional acceleration relative to this maiden field. Maps to settle handy (P) and launch late.

Live danger runner from the Chris Waller barn. Second-up off a sharp 4th of 10 at Newcastle over 1300m where she closed off nicely from 8th on the turn. Receives massive weight relief carrying the 55.0kg featherweight, getting 4.0kg from the favorite. Placed in barrier 2 to get an economical rail run before unleashing down the 410m straight. Fits the swooper (S) profile perfectly on Soft 5 going.

Another Chris Waller 3yo showing steady race-to-race progression. Ran two solid 5ths at Newcastle, beaten only 2.0L and 2.5L when getting back and making ground late. Neutral 56.5kg carrying weight and an inside draw allow him to save ground before utilizing the cambered bends to sustain his run as a swooper (S). Definite podium chance.

Victorian shipper transferring into the Chris Waller Sydney camp. Led the field over 1400m at Sale two starts ago before tiring late on rain-affected turf. Has struggled to make an impression in two career outings, finishing 6th beaten 7.8L at Hawkesbury on heavy ground and 7th beaten 7L at Nowra. Speed figures are subpar compared to the top contenders and will need massive turnaround to challenge for the minors.

Eleven-start maiden who was beaten 12 lengths at Kembla Grange over 1200m on November 3. Form has regressed significantly this preparation and cannot be recommended in this company despite the minimum weight.
